Capability: Hashes deterministic JSON values, asset bytes and external artifacts into SHA-256 records and assembles an audit manifest of solver stamp, rule-pack references and asset entries.
Notes: Number strings are caller-supplied and not normalised to RFC 8785; keys sorted via BTreeMap. Listed as a desktop native-shell dependency but not called directly there; reached through the report package container.

Capability: Validates an audit manifest and reports coded findings for missing hashes, privacy and redistribution posture, and professional-boundary flags.
Notes: In-memory only; does not read project files.

Capability: Validates a calculation report record (status, diagnostics, template slots, provenance, rule-pack references, unresolved TBDs) and yields the fixed required-section order.
Notes: Type and validation basis consumed by the HTML renderer, PDF emitter and package crates; no direct application caller. A separate Python schema check exists for the record shape but does not execute this crate.

Capability: Validates report disclosure sections (warnings, assumptions, user-supplied values, provenance notes, limitations, unresolved TBDs, human-review findings) and sorts diagnostics.
Notes: Consumed by renderer, PDF emitter and package crates only.

Capability: Renders a validated calculation report, disclosure sections and result rows into one self-contained scriptless HTML document whose SHA-256 is recorded as rendered-report evidence.
Notes: Reached from the desktop native render command. The assembled section model is shared with the PDF emitter. Byte layout is fixed; section order never follows input order.

Capability: Blocks report export when the bundled template, the assembled pre-render section text or the final rendered text trips a blocking protected-content finding or validation diagnostic.
Notes: Gate outcome is an export-blocked flag plus reasons; uses the protected-content lint engine. Heuristic, not a clearance.

Capability: Produces a derived print-oriented view of the canonical HTML report that carries the canonical hash and is marked as non-hash-bound.
Notes: Returned alongside the canonical HTML by the desktop render command.

Capability: Emits a byte-deterministic minimal PDF (text, tables, banners; base-14 fonts; uncompressed; fixed metadata) of the calculation report from the shared section model.
Notes: No font embedding or compression; PDF text model is linted after emission. Only caller is the report package crate.

Capability: Emits the HTML and PDF report from one assembled section model and records per-member SHA-256 hashes as a paired rendered-report outcome.
Notes: Intermediate step feeding the package container.

Capability: Assembles a byte-deterministic .opsproj project-package archive (stored ZIP, fixed order and timestamps) with a manifest of canonical-JSON members and per-member hashes.
Notes: Members: rendered HTML, PDF, audit manifest, result-export envelopes, state/comparison/handoff sections. Evidence binds to manifest member hashes, not raw archive bytes. Browser dist refuses save (desktop-only).

Capability: Accepts a wire-format report-package request, maps its DTOs to domain records with the linked solver identity, and assembles the package container.
Notes: Used by the desktop save-report-package command (behind redaction and local-first evidence checks) and by the headless runner export-results path.

Capability: Validates a result export envelope (families, units, trace links, provenance, reproducibility, boundary flags), orders values and serialises it to a schema-first JSON document.
Notes: Also used by the headless runner and the mechanics and stress benchmark crates. Listed as a desktop native-shell dependency but not called directly there.

Capability: Derives and validates a result derivative document from separately qualified source evidence, with canonical-JSON digests and checksum records.
Notes: Does not authenticate input; origin qualification is left to callers (headless solve API, desktop adapter). Guards against non-finite or unsafe JSON values.

Capability: Looks up exact result-row semantics (kind, unit, family, disposition) from a pinned semantic contract, refusing ID-substring or unit-only inference.
Notes: Embeds a fixture file at compile time from fixtures/results; panics if that file is malformed.

Capability: Scans caller-supplied report, template, example and fixture text for synthetic protected-content and private-data markers and professional-claim phrases, returning routed findings.
Notes: Heuristic, deterministic markers; private surfaces are skipped by default. Includes a table-signature heuristic. Not a legal clearance. A Python schema check covers the lint-run record shape only.

Capability: Command-line tool that lints named text files with the protected-content engine and prints a JSON finding list for the release-candidate scan.
Notes: Local only; findings are informational and do not sign or clear a release.

Capability: Builds deterministic report-section records summarising model-state, analysis-run, comparison, handoff, export-workflow and external-prover records, with diagnostics.
Notes: Python only; no product runtime caller found. The desktop has a separate TypeScript implementation that cites this module as its source.

Capability: Builds report sections from a canonical persisted project's embedded run-history records without mutating persistence or solver state.
Notes: Reached only from tests.

Capability: Wraps a computed preview mechanics result into an immutable analysis-run record with provenance, diagnostics, result hashes and boundary flags, and validates its invariants.
Notes: Hash serialiser is sorted compact ASCII JSON, explicitly not RFC 8785. Called by the Python preview service.

Capability: Constructs strict version 0.2 analysis-run records with checked canonical hashes and verifies records by version dispatch and projection.
Notes: Relies on the shared checked canonical-JSON adapter.

Capability: Verifies a legacy analysis-run checksum against its exact historical preimage without re-deriving it under a newer profile.
Notes: Read-only verification.

Capability: Compares two analysis runs and their result envelopes using explicit result mappings and unit metadata, reporting result deltas, settings deltas and diagnostics.
Notes: No numerical acceptance defaults; diagnostic only. Python only, reached from tests.

Capability: Derives automatic result mappings only where result IDs match exactly and unambiguously, leaving others for manual mapping.
Notes: Deliberately excludes heuristic matching.

Capability: Compares two model states by stable entity identifiers and returns a deterministic added/removed/changed diff envelope.
Notes: Result deltas out of scope. Python only, reached from tests.

Capability: Records provider-neutral target mapping metadata with unsupported or approximate behaviour and diagnostics for missing mapping context.
Notes: No commercial target is selected.

Capability: Assembles handoff and target-mapping records into a deterministic provider-neutral export envelope and runs it through the controlled export route.
Notes: Does not invoke external solvers or ingest results. Python only, reached from tests.

Capability: Builds non-authoritative external-prover metadata (workflow references, notes, attachments, assumptions, warnings, unsupported-target flags) with diagnostics.
Notes: Invokes no external tool.

Capability: Screens user-controlled handoff metadata for prohibited authority or reliance wording and reports the terms found.
Notes: Shared by every handoff package builder in this area.

Capability: Builds a native open JSON interchange package preserving model identity, stable IDs, units, provenance, diagnostics and loss reporting, and writes it through the controlled route.
Notes: Python only, reached from tests; no desktop or API caller found.

Capability: Renders a narrow invented subset of a model to CAEPIPE MBF-style text with sidecar stable-ID map, loss report and diagnostics, writing only when redaction is lossless.
Notes: Smoke subset only; no claim of target compatibility; does not invoke the external tool. Reached only from tests.

Capability: Records deterministic evidence for skipped, parser-only or user-owned external CAEPIPE runs, including parsing an invented CSV result fixture into neutral rows.
Notes: Does not discover, install or launch the tool (no subprocess use found). Writes are local-private and need wrapper-owned intent. Reached only from tests.

Capability: Builds a stress-neutral CSV/JSON results package (units, source refs, stable IDs, loss report, diagnostics) and writes CSV members only when redaction is lossless.
Notes: Version 0.1 builder kept byte-stable; serialiser is not RFC 8785. Reached only from tests; API contract lists the export job as TBD.

Capability: Builds, validates and materialises the strict version 0.2 stress-neutral package as nine members with checked canonical hashes.
Notes: Decorates the 0.1 normalised data. Reached only from tests.

Capability: Emits a conservative ASCII PCF text package for an invented subset with an authoritative sidecar identity map, loss report and diagnostics.
Notes: No claim of PCF completeness or import compatibility. Reached only from tests.

Capability: Emits a glTF JSON line-mode centreline review-geometry package with sidecar mappings, loss report and diagnostics.
Notes: Vertex data is embedded as a base64 data-URI buffer inside the JSON; no GLB or tube surfaces. Reached only from tests.

Capability: Records target-admission and adapter-boundary evidence for adding further export targets through an adapter SDK package.
Notes: Loads no plugins and grants no permissions. Reached only from tests.

Capability: Evaluates typed rule-pack expression trees with dimension algebra, comparisons, logic, select, min/max and table interpolation or lookup, blocking on out-of-range lookups.
Notes: Sandboxed: no text parser, no host code, files, network or plugins. Reached through the rule-pack document and rule-check crates.

Capability: Declares the frozen expression grammar version and reports whether a declared grammar version is supported.
Notes: Grammar changes require extending the conformance corpus fixture set (outside this area).

Capability: Converts between the node-tagged JSON expression encoding in rule-pack documents and the evaluator's typed expression tree, including dimension tokens.
Notes: No expression text syntax exists yet. Detects refusal markers in expressions.

Capability: Computes a rule-pack checksum as SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 canonical document with the checksums member excluded, bound to the declared grammar version.
Notes: Reached from a desktop native checksum command.

Capability: Validates a rule-pack document and surfaces lifecycle, grammar, formula and checksum findings for the desktop rule-pack editor.
Notes: Considers whether public export is requested.

Capability: Validates rule-pack lifecycle metadata (privacy, redistribution, review and lifecycle status, checksum records) and checks that the payload binds the declared grammar version.
Notes: Grammar binding is a byte-containment necessary condition, not proof of canonical form. Stores no private payloads. Reached through the rule-pack document crate.

Capability: Checks declared required inputs of a user rule pack against supplied input evidence and reports readiness and coded findings for missing, invalid or unreviewed values.
Notes: No code-specific defaults. Reached only through the rule-check runner.

Capability: Runs every check in a rule pack end to end (completeness, formula decode and evaluation, ratio-versus-limit acceptability) and aggregates per-check statuses worst-of.
Notes: Statuses are inputs-incomplete, checked or failed. Solver, user and private-library values are bound by the caller; unresolved library inputs stay unsupplied. Reached from a desktop native command.

Capability: Classifies storage records by explicit metadata and decides allow, redact or block per context, rejecting remote and direct-SQL routes for private records.
Notes: Metadata only; never touches payloads or files. Python only.

Capability: Admits a governed export route from route metadata only, requiring wrapper-owned intent for local-private routes and ignoring payload-carried intent.
Notes: Called from the redaction route wrapper.

Capability: Returns a redacted copy of a report or export payload with findings, deciding sensitivity only from explicit metadata and treating unlabelled values as unresolved.
Notes: Never mutates the source. The desktop has a separate TypeScript port that cites this module.

Capability: Wraps a fixed-context export route: strips payload-carried intent, projects values into metadata, applies local-first and redaction checks, and materialises only the controlled copy.
Notes: Every handoff package writer in this area passes through it with a hard-coded route identifier.

Capability: Classifies private-library, private-path, secret-field and credential-placeholder references by metadata and gates their release with a metadata-only manifest.
Notes: Never stores values or reads referenced files. Desktop panels cite this module by path only; no runtime call.

Capability: Resolves telemetry configuration to a default-off state and evaluates each telemetry event attempt before any payload is built.
Notes: No transport or vendor. Desktop panels cite this module by path only; no runtime call.

Capability: Validates format-neutral adapter declarations and invented fixtures for no-bypass controls, provenance, unit metadata, privacy/export posture and boundary controls.
Notes: Parses no real external formats. Python only, reached from tests.

Capability: Gates the declaration-to-runtime adapter dispatch seam, stopping invalid or quarantined declarations and also stopping valid ones because no runtime exists.
Notes: Always non-dispatching by design; no loader exists.

Capability: Verifies fail-closed controls on an already-loaded plugin manifest and composes it with adapter declaration checks.
Notes: Never loads or dispatches a plugin; runtime remains blocked. Python only, reached from tests.
